facts.fact: The only Featured Article about a dinosaur promoted on English Wikipedia in November 2016 is about Giganotosaurus.
The user who nominated the Giganotosaurus article for Featured Article status is FunkMonk.
Giganotosaurus is considered one of the largest known meat-eating dinosaurs.
The Giganotosaurus article is one of the most viewed dinosaur articles on Wikipedia.
The Featured Articles promoted in November 2016 include other topics, but Giganotosaurus is the only dinosaur.

result.summary: In November 2016, the only dinosaur Featured Article promoted on English Wikipedia was about Giganotosaurus, nominated by FunkMonk. This article is notable for being one of the largest known meat-eating dinosaurs and is highly viewed on the platform.
